title: 開放ワイヤーバスケット付きディスクゴルフ的
titleEn: Disc-golf target with open wire basket
description: 公園のディスクゴルフ区画に配置する、中心ポール式ターゲットの一式。開放したワイヤーバスケット、上下の円環、交互に向きを変えた楕円リンクのチェーン列、透けた上部クラウン、支えスポーク、ポール固定カラーとボルト付き接地板を造形。ディスクは含まず、全体で1点です。チェーンの揺れ・捕球判定はなく、競技規格や実用品の安全性は未検証です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.752 × 1.788 × 0.752 m、91,376三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A center-pole disc-golf target assembly for park course scenes. It has an open wire basket, upper/lower rings, courses of alternating oval chain links, an open top crown, support spokes, pole collars and a bolted grounded plate. No disc is included; the whole target counts as one model. Chain movement and catching behavior are absent; competition specifications and real-equipment safety are unvalidated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.752 × 1.788 × 0.752 m; 91,376 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
